meta.title: 悬垂腹 腹内压过大不着急卷腹，懒人躺练有效版❗
meta.title_en: Saggy Belly & High Intra-Abdominal Pressure? Skip Crunches — Try This Lazy Lying Routine
meta.topic: 健身教学 · 核心训练

scenes.title_cn: 开场：悬垂腹不着急卷腹
scenes.context: 悬垂腹、腹内压过大的人先别急着卷腹，这两个躺练动作很有效。动作一：臀部垫高、腹部收紧、屈膝、脚尖点地，配合呼吸发力。语域：健身教学，先给结论再讲动作。
sentences: 这两个动作，对悬垂腹、腹内压过大很有效果。
These two moves are highly effective for a saggy belly and high intra-abdominal pressure.
intra-abdominal pressure（腹内压）
将臀部垫高，腹部收紧，屈膝，脚尖点地。
Elevate your hips, tighten your abs, bend your knees, and rest your toes on the floor.
elevate your hips（臀部垫高）；bend your knees（屈膝）
配合呼吸发力，吸气下落，呼气收腹腿抬高。
Coordinate with your breath: inhale as you lower, exhale as you draw in and lift your legs.
coordinate with your breath（配合呼吸）
paraphrase: 腹内压 → intra-abdominal pressure / pressure in the abdomen
配合呼吸 → coordinate with your breath / breathe in rhythm
coordinate with breath · breathe in rhythm
scenes.speak: These two moves are highly effective for a saggy belly and high intra-abdominal pressure. Elevate your hips, tighten your abs, bend your knees, and rest your toes on the floor. Coordinate with your breath: inhale as you lower, exhale as you draw in and lift your legs.

scenes.title_en: Advanced: Straighten Legs to Tighten Core
scenes.context: 有基础的可以把腿伸直，这样核心收得更紧、效果更好。动作二：脚踩沙发，双腿夹住瑜伽球，臀部向上抬高，双臂向内夹紧，手臂呈三角形稳定支撑。语域：健身教学，进阶讲解。
sentences: 有基础的把腿伸直，这样核心收得更紧。
If you're more advanced, straighten your legs to squeeze your core even tighter.
squeeze your core（收紧核心）
脚踩沙发，双腿夹住瑜伽球，臀部向上抬高。
Feet on the sofa, legs squeezing a yoga ball, and lift your hips up.
yoga ball（瑜伽球）；lift your hips（抬高臀部）
双臂向内夹紧，手臂呈三角形稳定支撑。
Draw your arms in tight, forming a stable triangle support.
a triangle support（三角支撑）
paraphrase: 核心收紧 → squeeze the core / engage the core
squeeze the core · engage the core
三角支撑 → a triangle support / a tripod stance
scenes.speak: If you're more advanced, straighten your legs to squeeze your core even tighter. Feet on the sofa, legs squeezing a yoga ball, and lift your hips up. Draw your arms in tight, forming a stable triangle support.

scenes.title_cn: 呼吸：吸气放松呼气收紧
scenes.title_en: Breathing: Inhale to Relax, Exhale to Tighten
scenes.context: 吸气时腹部隆起，整个腹部和盆底都放松；呼气时感觉把气全部吐出去，双腿向内夹紧瑜伽球，感受盆底肌收紧发力。语域：健身教学，呼吸口令。
sentences: 吸气腹部隆起，整个腹部盆底都放松。
Inhale and let your belly rise — your whole abdomen and pelvic floor relax.
pelvic floor（盆底）
呼气，感觉把气全部吐出去。
Exhale as if you're pushing all the air out.
push all the air out（全部吐出）
双腿向内夹紧瑜伽球，感受盆底肌收紧发力。
Squeeze the ball inward and feel your pelvic-floor muscles tighten.
pelvic-floor muscles（盆底肌）
paraphrase: 盆底肌 → pelvic-floor muscles / deep core
全部吐出 → push all the air out / breathe out completely
push air out · breathe out fully
scenes.speak: Inhale and let your belly rise — your whole abdomen and pelvic floor relax. Exhale as if you're pushing all the air out. Squeeze the ball inward and feel your pelvic-floor muscles tighten.

scenes.title_en: Closing: Save It, But Also Do It
scenes.context: UP主提醒：很多人只会收藏不练。这两个动作对悬垂腹和腹内压过大真的有效，关键在于坚持执行。语域：健身教学，口语提醒。
sentences: 我试着和所有女生解释，这两个动作很有效果。
I keep telling every girl these two moves actually work.
actually work（真的有效）
可是你只会收藏。
But all you ever do is save the post.
save the post（收藏）
收藏了，也要记得练。
Save the video, but remember to actually do it.
actually do it（真正去做）
paraphrase: 只会收藏 → all you do is save the post / you just bookmark it
记得练 → remember to do it / put it into practice
remember to do · put into practice
scenes.speak: I keep telling every girl these two moves actually work. But all you ever do is save the post. Save the video, but remember to actually do it.

practice: These two moves are highly effective for a saggy belly and high intra-abdominal pressure.
Straighten your legs to squeeze your core even tighter.
Inhale and let your belly rise; exhale and push all the air out.
Save the video, but remember to actually do it.
pitfalls: The belly is too high pressure.
「腹内压过高」是 high intra-abdominal pressure，不是 belly pressure。
Put your butt high, use a pillow.
「垫高臀部」用 elevate your hips，比 put your butt high 更规范。
Inhale the belly big, exhale the belly small.
Inhale and let your belly rise; exhale and push all the air out.
描述呼吸用 rise（隆起）和 push out（吐出），不用 big/small。
All you ever do is save the post.
「只会收藏」用 save the post（收藏笔记）。
shifts: 说肚子大只会 belly big
用 saggy belly（悬垂腹）、high intra-abdominal pressure（腹内压过高）
用 squeeze your core（夹紧核心）、engage（发力）、pelvic-floor muscles（盆底肌）
说练动作只会 do exercise
用 elevate hips（垫高臀部）、triangle support（三角支撑）、coordinate with breath（配合呼吸）
